'''2022 MPC Jarad Konsker DS SYCFA''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jarad Konsker]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jarad Konsker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open SYCFA Konsker DS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
